transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support, my name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Craig, my name is Isabel Ward. We recently completed a loft conversion for my home office, but our S-Net Hub 5 Wi-Fi signal in the loft drops from three hundred megabits down to ten megabits with continuous disconnects!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning Isabel. I can inspect your Hub 5 wireless frequency distribution and mesh coverage options. Before we check your network settings, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 53 Victoria Road, Oxford, OX2 7TA, and my security PIN is 6620. My broadband subscription reference is SN-330192.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Isabel, that confirms your account details. Where is your Hub 5 router physically located in the house?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The router is on the ground floor in the front hallway near the master phone socket because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what has occurred is that while your Hub 5 delivers strong wireless throughput on the ground floor, structural attenuation through two floors and foil-backed insulation into the loft reduces speeds to ten megabits with packet loss, is that right in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what is happening! Craig, I run an online psychotherapy practice from that loft office, and my remote patient video consultations keep freezing and cutting off mid-sentence! My vulnerable therapy clients feel abandoned and distressed, and it is completely ruining my professional practice! I am frantic with worry so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I run our remote Wi-Fi home mapping diagnostic across your Hub 5 client telemetry across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Isabel. The client telemetry shows your laptop connected to the five gigahertz radio band at minus eighty-four dBm Received Signal Strength, which is right on the fringe of signal drop to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What can be done to get a stable, fast signal up to the third floor so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: High-frequency five gigahertz wireless radio waves suffer severe absorption through modern building building materials like foil-faced Celotex thermal insulation in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know foil insulation blocks radio waves, Craig! That is why I am calling you! Do I need a Wi-Fi booster or a mesh node since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To bridge the vertical distance, an S-Net Smart Wi-Fi Mesh Booster should be positioned midway on the first-floor landing across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you dispatch a Smart Wi-Fi Mesh Booster to my address today because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your Fibre 300 package qualifies for a Smart Wi-Fi Booster pod under our whole-home Wi-Fi guarantee to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does the booster pod link to the Hub 5 router so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It pairs automatically using a single dedicated backhaul wireless channel and creates a seamless unified roaming network so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously building regulations require foil-backed insulation boards in modern roof spaces across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our builder had to comply with strict insulation standards so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The first-floor booster pod will catch the strong ground-floor signal and beam high-speed coverage directly up the open loft staircase to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That open staircase provides a direct line of sight between the first-floor landing and my office desk since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Placing the pod near the landing socket will typically boost loft RSSI to minus fifty-five dBm and restore two hundred megabits throughput.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make video consultations completely smooth and reliable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am submitting the hardware order for an S-Net Smart Wi-Fi Mesh Pod right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the delivery timescale for the mesh pod?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The mesh pod will dispatch via Royal Mail Tracked 24 and arrive tomorrow afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow afternoon is very fast. What is the order tracking reference?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The dispatch order reference identifier is POD-99120-W.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: POD-99120-W, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the interim, you can force your laptop to connect to the 2.4 gigahertz band, which penetrates structural floors more effectively than five gigahertz.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will switch to 2.4 gigahertz for this afternoon's remaining therapy sessions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our automated Wi-Fi optimizer will configure the backhaul radio channels as soon as you plug the pod in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The setup sounds very simple.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can verify the connection strength of the booster pod using the My S-Net mobile application.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have the app downloaded and ready to pair the pod.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude our call, that account contact telephone number was 01865 240192, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 01865 240192 is my home landline.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have identified the structural loft attenuation, ordered the Smart Wi-Fi Mesh Pod for tomorrow, and provided reference POD-99120-W.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Craig, you have provided a practical solution.
